subject: social_studies
concept: Addressing genuine counterarguments and practical obstacles to the proposed civic action
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student matches their proposal to its strongest plausible objection
exercise.abstract: Student identifies a genuine obstacle or counterargument to their proposal and explains how they'd respond to it

assessment.mastery_threshold: presents a genuine, strong obstacle and a substantive response, not a weak strawman
misconception_flags: presents an easily dismissed objection instead of the strongest real obstacle to their proposal

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
